title: Patch: the Shop screen holds buying packs, opening packs and pity, out of the account menu
thread:
**Issue #1580 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1580: Patch: the Shop screen holds buying packs, opening packs and pity, out of the account menu
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul). Read the tracker's Goals first.

Blocked by #1577
Blocked by #1579 (both edit the account menu; this one goes second to avoid the conflict)

## What

The screen behind the **Shop** door is the one place for spending and opening:

- **Buying packs** (card packs and the cosmetic packs, `shop/Shop.tsx`, `shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`), with the wallet the player spends from.
- **Opening packs** the player holds (`packs/PackOpening.tsx`).
- **Pity stats**: how close each pack's pity is, shown plainly next to the pack it belongs to.
- Anything else of the same kind the planner finds tucked away (the token picker, etc.).

All of these come **out of the account menu** (`routes/account.tsx`), which keeps account things only. Old URLs redirect (CLAUDE.md rule 13).

## Done when

- The Shop fits one screen without page scrolling on desktop and on a phone; the pack opening itself still plays full screen as it does now.
- The account menu no longer offers packs, pack opening or pity; its tests say so.
- Tests prove buying, opening and pity are reached from Shop, and the old entry points lead here.
- e2e specs that bought or opened packs through the account menu are updated.

Prices, odds and pity rules are unchanged: this moves screens, it changes no number (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
```
